forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,45 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8380'
+title: 'ROUTER-3: Move SessionIndex and ProjectRegistry from ACPAgent Transcripts/ into Router Recording/'
+---
+## Goal
+Router owns the record of past sessions (D72): `SessionIndex` (`sessions.jsonl`) and `ProjectRegistry` (`projects.jsonl`) become public Router types, with the same file names and the same line formats, so the files on a user's disk stay valid.
+
+## Spec
+- /Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/TestudoApp/features/packages/foundationmodels-router.md#router-3-session-directory (second paragraph)
+- /Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsRouter/session.md section 5.2 ("The record of past sessions moves into Router")
+- /Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsMultitool/session.md section 14 (ROUTER-3, ACPA-14)
+
+## What
+- Copy, as public Router types, from `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsACPAgent/Sources/FoundationModelsACPAgent/Transcripts/`:
+  - `SessionIndex.swift` → `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsRouter/Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Recording/SessionIndex.swift` (`SessionIndexRecord`, `SessionIndexWarning`, `SessionIndexError`, `SessionIndexReadResult`, `SessionIndex` with `append`, `read`, `removeRecords(sessionId:)`, `rebuild(cwd:)`, `.gitattributes` materialization).
+  - `ProjectRegistry.swift` → `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsRouter/Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Recording/ProjectRegistry.swift` (`ProjectRegistryRecord`, `ProjectRegistry` with `recordSessionStart(workingDirectory:at:)` and `projects()`).
+  - Replace the ACPAgent `JSONLines` helper with Router's own `Recording/JSONLAppend.swift` (`appendJSONLine`, `openHandleForAppending`) where it fits; if a helper is still needed (encoder/decoder with RFC 3339 dates), add it as internal `Recording/JSONLines.swift`. The encoded bytes of a record must not change.
+  - Use Router's `sessionSidecarFileName` (`Recording/SessionSidecar.swift`) in place of the copy in `SessionIndex.sidecarFileName`.
+- Do not change ACPAgent here. ACPA-14 (ACPAgent repo) removes its copies and uses the Router types. Until then ACPAgent has same-named types of its own module; Swift prefers the module's own declaration, so ACPAgent still builds. Note this in the commit message.
+- No GraphQL, no ACP type, no `RecordedSessionCatalog` port.
+
+## Subtasks
+- [ ] Failing test first: move `SessionIndexTests.swift` and `ProjectRegistryTests.swift` from `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsACPAgent/Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentTests/` into Router's test target; they fail to compile until the types exist.
+- [ ] Add a compatibility test: a `sessions.jsonl` and a `projects.jsonl` written byte-for-byte as the ACPAgent code writes them today (a checked-in literal) read back to the expected records.
+- [ ] Add the two public types in `Recording/`, with doc comments that say Router owns the record (D72).
+- [ ] Encoding test: `append` of a record gives the same line bytes as the ACPAgent encoder (the same literal).
+- [ ] Public surface test for both types.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] The moved tests pass in `FoundationModelsRouterTests`, with no change to their assertions other than imports.
+- [ ] A file written by the old ACPAgent code reads to the same records, and a torn final line gives `SessionIndexWarning.tornFinalLine`.
+- [ ] `append` writes the same bytes as the ACPAgent version for the same record.
+- [ ] Router's library target imports no ACP module (the existing package manifest checks stay green).
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsRouter/Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/SessionIndexTests.swift`
+- [ ] `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsRouter/Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/ProjectRegistryTests.swift`
+- [ ] `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsRouter/Tests/FoundationModelsRouterPublicSurfaceTests/SessionRecordPublicSurfaceTests.swift`
+- [ ] `swift test --filter "SessionIndex|ProjectRegistry"` passes; the full `swift test` stays green.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #session #recording #cross-repo
\ No newline at end of file
